name: Precision Power Attack (Combat)
body:
A swing, and a miss, or so your thought.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: When using Power Attack, if you fail to hit the creature’s armor class, but would have hit the creature if it was flat-footed, they suffer damage equal to the Power Attack bonus damage.

Normal: On a missed attack the creature takes no damage.
